view: Frontal chest radiograph (recorded PA; appearance suggests AP/portable technique — scapulae projected over lung fields, multiple monitoring cables; left-side marker at image upper right with mirrored lettering, heart apex to image right, conventional orientation)
technical_quality: Limited. Both scapulae overlie the upper/mid lung fields; numerous ECG cables/external tubing coil over the thorax; large bilateral breast shadows obscure the lower zones and costophrenic angles. Mild rotation, roughly adequate inspiration and penetration (spine visible through upper mediastinum).

description_zh: 正面胸部X光，雙側肩胛骨重疊於肺野，胸前可見三枚心電圖電極貼片、多條纏繞之導線及一條斜行外部管線，影像判讀受限。右下肺野內側（近右心緣、橫膈上方）可見邊界不清之斑片狀實質浸潤，範圍約8公分，符合肺炎表現；左肺野大致清晰，左下後心區密度略增但因導線重疊難以確認。心影略為擴大（心胸比約0.55–0.58，可能部分為AP投照放大所致），雙側乳房陰影重疊於下肺野，肋膈角顯示不清，無法完全排除少量肋膜積液。未見胸管、中心靜脈導管、氣管內管或心律調節器。
